summary_1line: Ravana threatens Sita with death unless she yields within two months, but she defiantly condemns him and predicts Rama will destroy him.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana, towering and dark like a storm cloud with blazing eyes and golden ornaments, glares furiously at Sita seated beneath the Ashoka trees.
The grotesque female titans of Lanka—some with single eyes, animal feet, or tusked faces—gather around Sita as Ravana commands them to bend her will.
Dhanyamalini embraces Ravana to restrain him while he laughs scornfully and strides away toward his radiant palace.
